subject: Television & Streaming
title: Apple and Amazon Buy Their Way In
description: A fast breakdown of Apple and Amazon Buy Their Way In for builders.

hook.text: Apple TV+ launched with a tiny library and one strategy: spend billions on prestige shows and hope for awards.

buildup.text: Amazon's Prime Video bundled streaming with free shipping. Most subscribers didn't even know they had it.

discovery.text: Both companies could absorb losses that would bankrupt traditional media. Their streaming arms didn't need to profit.

twist.text: Apple won Oscars with CODA. Amazon bought MGM for $8.5 billion. Tech money reshaped who makes entertainment.

climax.text: Legacy studios now compete against companies with trillion-dollar valuations. The playing field is no longer level.

punchline.text: Tech giants don't need TV to profit. That's their advantage.

quiz.question: What major film studio did Amazon acquire to boost its streaming content?
